definitions.explanation: An outstanding or superb item, especially a product, dish, or work of art. Conveys a sense of refined quality and rarity.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{逸品|いっぴん}だ。
⟦{職人|しょくにん}→職人：09868_shokunin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{手作|てづく}り→手作り：08300_tezukuri⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧{逸品|いっぴん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}めた→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧。
examples.english: I collected masterpieces handmade by craftspeople.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{美術館|びじゅつかん}→美術館：01717_bijutsukan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{江戸時代|えどじだい}→江戸時代：20431_edojidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{逸品|いっぴん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{数多|かずおお}く→数多く：12948_kazuooku⟧⟦{展示|てんじ}→展示：12401_tenji⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This museum displays many masterpieces from the Edo period.

notes:
Describes something of exceptionally high quality — a standout item among many. Often used for food, crafts, and artwork, but can apply to any product or creation. The word carries a tone of admiration and connoisseurship.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{知|し}る→知る：00458_shiru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ぞ⟦{知|し}る→知る：00458_shiru⟧{逸品|いっぴん} — a hidden gem known only to connoisseurs
- {逸品|いっぴん}ぞろい — a collection of fine items
- ⟦まさに→まさに：00270_masani⟧{逸品|いっぴん} — truly a masterpiece
- ⟦{隠|かく}れた→隠れる：02035_kakureru⟧{逸品|いっぴん} — a hidden gem

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{一品|いっぴん}→一品：08919_ippin⟧ — a (single) dish or item; homophone but different nuance — refers to a single item/dish without implying excellence
- ⟦{名品|めいひん}→名品：19478_meihin⟧ — fine article, famous item; similar meaning but emphasizes fame or renown rather than pure quality
- ⟦{傑作|けっさく}→傑作：00217_kessaku⟧ — masterpiece; used more for creative works like literature, film, or art
